title: start's host-setup warning does not fire on a design gate that names a documentation host
goal: backlog.py start warns of a gate with no --host-check only when the gate names a setup of the machine the work runs on, not when 'host' names a documentation or web host the code is about. SP-vk3wf746 start: BG-npdpbmw2 g1 (clamp a provider-down record) drew the warning and needed gate host-unchecked by hand.

run:
import sys, tempfile, json, subprocess, os
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_base, bl_plan
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", d], check=True)
bl_base.load_settings(d)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, bl_base.rel_dir()), exist_ok=True)
def put(iid, question, options):
    item = {"id": iid, "kind": "story", "title": "t", "status": "todo", "sprint": "SP-aaaaaaaa", "priority": "P3", "rank": 0, "goal": "g", "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}], "touches": ["_tools/bench_pool.py"], "gates": [{"id": "g1", "question": question, "options": options, "kind": "provisional"}]}
    open(os.path.join(d, bl_base.rel_dir(), iid + ".json"), "w").write(json.dumps(item))
put("ST-aaaaaaaa", "How is a provider-down record clamped when the documentation host answers 503?", ["clamp to the last good record", "drop the record"])
put("ST-bbbbbbbb", "Which service must be enabled on this host before the work starts?", ["the daemon", "none"])
bl = bl_base.Backlog(d)
got = {i: w for i, g, w in bl_plan.free_text_host_gates(bl, "SP-aaaaaaaa")}
print(got)
ok = "ST-aaaaaaaa" not in got and "ST-bbbbbbbb" in got
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
